paragraphs.en: The PHP development team announces the immediate availability of PHP 8.2.35. This is a security release fixing two critical vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619) that can allow unauthenticated remote code execution. All PHP 8.2 users are strongly encouraged to update immediately.
paragraphs.zh: PHP 开发团队宣布 PHP 8.2.35 即刻可用。 这是一次安全发布，修复了两个可导致未经身份验证的远程代码执行的严重漏洞（CVE-2026-109618、CVE-2026-109619）。 强烈建议所有 PHP 8.2 用户立即更新。

sents.en: The PHP development team announces the immediate availability of PHP 8.2.35.
sents.zh: PHP 开发团队宣布 PHP 8.2.35 即刻可用。

sents.en: This is a security release fixing two critical vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619) that can allow unauthenticated remote code execution.
sents.zh: 这是一次安全发布，修复了两个可导致未经身份验证的远程代码执行的严重漏洞（CVE-2026-109618、CVE-2026-109619）。

sents.en: All PHP 8.2 users are strongly encouraged to update immediately.
sents.zh: 强烈建议所有 PHP 8.2 用户立即更新。

paragraphs.en: There are no complete mitigations, updating is the only safe choice. See the security advisory for details.
paragraphs.zh: 没有完整的缓解措施，更新是唯一安全的选择。 详情请参阅安全公告。

sents.en: There are no complete mitigations, updating is the only safe choice.
sents.zh: 没有完整的缓解措施，更新是唯一安全的选择。

sents.en: See the security advisory for details.

paragraphs.en: PHP 8.2 reaches end of life on 31 December 2026 and will receive no further security fixes after that date. Please plan your upgrade to a supported version.
paragraphs.zh: PHP 8.2 将于 2026 年 12 月 31 日到达生命周期终点，此后将不再收到安全修复。 请规划升级到受支持的版本。
